# BrowserKit Studio

> High-Speed, 100% Client-Side Web Utilities Suite.

BrowserKit Studio (browserkit.co.in) provides browser-native tools for media processing, PDF operations, image compression, video editing, and file encryption. All computations execute locally in browser memory using WebAssembly and HTML5 APIs with zero server uploads.

## Primary Tool Suites

- [PDF Tools Suite](https://browserkit.co.in/pdf-tools): Merge, Split, Compress, Sign, Protect, Edit & OCR PDFs.
- [Image Tools Suite](https://browserkit.co.in/image-tools): Compress Under 100KB, Passport Photo Maker, HEIC to JPG, 300 DPI Signature Resizer.
- [Video & Audio Suite](https://browserkit.co.in/video-tools): Aspect Ratio Resizer (9:16 TikTok/Reels), Video to 320kbps MP3 Audio, Audio Cutter, Video Trimmer, Thumbnail Grabber.
- [Archive & Vault Suite](https://browserkit.co.in/zip-tools): ZIP Archiver, Extractor, ZIP Password Remover & AES-256 Vault Encryption.

## Privacy & Security

- 100% Client-Side Processing: Zero file uploads to any remote server.
- WebAssembly & HTML5 Native execution.
- No account or registration required.
